product_commit.builder_change: The canonical one-file builder now performs two independent PyInstaller freezes with separate work/spec/dist paths under fixed PYTHONHASHSEED=1 and fails closed if the two EntityOS SHA-256 values differ.

hypothesis: For the exact accepted build toolchain and host, fixing PYTHONHASHSEED and independently freezing the same source/build identity should remove the remaining observed PyInstaller archive-order nondeterminism and produce bit-identical EntityOS executables.
counter_hypothesis: Hidden time/path/cache/toolchain entropy can still change the final one-file ELF even when PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed.
discriminating_test: Build the exact same product head twice in isolated PyInstaller work/spec/dist trees and compare the final EntityOS SHA-256 before accepting the build.

unusual_experiment.name: ONEFILE_RELOCATED_UNICODE_TMPDIR_FOREIGN_CWD
unusual_experiment.intervention: Copy exact EntityOS into a path containing spaces and Unicode, use a Unicode TMPDIR, execute from foreign cwd '/', and compare self-test JSON against baseline.

grf_collapse.retained: On the exact current accepted build lane, fixed-seed independent double-freeze reproducibility is verified and now enforced as a build invariant.
grf_collapse.counterevidence_preserved: This does not establish cross-distribution portability or whole Clay Machine completion; the build host used glibc 2.39 and the canonical language/runtime/effect surface remains incomplete.

release_blocker.exact_blocking_invariant: Whole-machine acceptance remains false because canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime and String/argv/effect-signature semantics plus broader process/network/media/runtime capability paths are not yet fully admitted through ClayCode -> TypedIR -> single ClayVM -> ClayOS.
release_blocker.next_executable_step: Implement and gate the smallest canonical String/Bytes/argv value plus effect-signature slice that drives one provenance-bound real process request through TypedIR, the single ClayVM and ClayOS without backend-local semantics, then rebuild and re-run the exact one-file EntityOS gates.
